name: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me
original_name: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me
overview: An unassuming secretary drawn into her billionaire boss's twisted schemes, a gunshot wound and a plea to spy on his wife, the shocking discovery that the wound was self-inflicted to frame her and seize the family fortune, the wife's ruthless counter-scheming, a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, and the secretary's entanglement in a web of lies, betrayal, and deadly secrets.
